title: Create src/lib/feature/taskMerger.ts — append new tasks to tasks.json
description: Create a module that reads the current tasks.json, finds the maximum task ID, and appends new tasks with sequential IDs. Validates each new task against the schema before writing.
acceptanceCriteria: New tasks get IDs continuing from previous max+1
Existing tasks in the file are unchanged
Each new task is validated against TaskSchema before writing
Empty newTasks array adds nothing and returns correctly

steps.details: Create the file. Import fs-extra, TaskSchema, Task from schema.ts. Define function signature.
Read existing tasks.json. Find max ID: const maxId = Math.max(0, ...existingTasks.map(t => t.id)). Assign new IDs: newTasks.map((t, i) => ({ ...t, id: maxId + 1 + i }))

Validate each new task: tasksWithIds.forEach(t => TaskSchema.parse(t)). Merge and write: await fs.writeJson(tasksPath, { tasks: [...existingTasks, ...tasksWithIds] }, { spaces: 2 }). Return { added: newTasks.length, newMaxId: maxId + newTasks.length }

technicalNotes: Validate ALL new tasks before writing any — fail atomically if any task is invalid
